description: Your Editorial Circle standing: stats (credit balance, earned30d, spent30d, creditValue, optedIn; byReason and byReason30d split your credits, all time and for the last 30 days, into starting, earnedByHosting, takenBack, spentOnReceived and returned; startingCreditsAt is when your starting credits were given) and placements in two lists, hosted (links on your articles) and received (links to your site). Each placement has partner, page titles, targetUrl, anchorText, introSentence (the sentence the hosting article gained) and insertAfterPhrase (the words it follows), credits, status, createdAt and lastVerifiedAt (its last check), newest first.
name: get_editorial_circle
